svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. 4 mm 6082-T6 aluminium, 50 outside, 22 bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from plate offcuts; do not use steel washers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One ring each side of each eye, the bores in line with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 eye hole within 0.5 mm (use a 22 pin to line them up).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TIG weld all round the outside, 3 mm fillet, ER5356 filler;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no weld in the bore. Keep 4 mm: the quick link must pass.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After welding, round the bore edges to 2 mm radius, so a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: carabiner bears on a smooth curve, never a sharp edge.
